ruleset.name: search-index-alias-parameter-list
ruleset.description: Parameter-count check, exempting Facades and orchestrator-style coordinators: a module Facade's public API grows with the feature set over time, and RebuildOrchestrator takes one collaborator per genuinely orthogonal step of the blue-green rebuild pipeline (rollout lifecycle, naming, cloning, mapping diff, bulk load, mirror queue bind/drain, alias switching, persistence, async dispatch, the auto-flip flag). Collapsing either into a single options array/DTO would trade a self-documenting, individually-typed dependency list for an equally large but less discoverable one, not actually reduce complexity. Run as its own phpmd invocation, separate from phpmd.xml — see that file's description for why.
